job.title: Market & Liquidity Risk Business Analyst
job.description:
Market & Liquidity Risk Business Analyst (VP)

Location: London (Hybrid)

Overview
We are seeking an experienced VP-level Business Analyst to support a range of Market Risk and Liquidity Risk initiatives within a global investment banking environment. The role will involve working closely with Risk, Treasury, Finance, Front Office and Technology teams to deliver regulatory, strategic and system change programmes.

Key Responsibilities
• Gather, analyse and document business requirements.
• Facilitate workshops with Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, Treasury and Technology stakeholders.
• Produce functional specifications, process flows, data mapping and user stories.
• Support solution design, testing, implementation and business adoption.
• Perform impact assessments across risk systems, processes and data flows.
• Support regulatory and risk transformation projects.

Required Market & Liquidity Risk Knowledge
• Market Risk: VaR, Expected Shortfall, Stress Testing, FRTB, P&L Attribution, Risk Sensitivities (DV01, CS01, Vega).
• Liquidity Risk: LCR, NSFR, ILAAP, Liquidity Stress Testing, Funding and Treasury Risk.
• Understanding of regulatory risk reporting and risk governance frameworks.

Essential Skills & Experience
• Significant Business Analysis experience within Investment Banking or Capital Markets.
• Strong Market Risk and/or Liquidity Risk domain knowledge.
• Experience delivering regulatory or risk management change initiatives.
• Ability to work with senior business stakeholders and technology teams.
• Strong data analysis and documentation skills.
• Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.

Candidate Profile
An experienced, hands-on Business Analyst capable of operating at VP level, with strong stakeholder management skills and a proven track record of delivering risk technology and regulatory change initiatives within a banking environment.

job.title: BI Developer (Sigma, ETL)
job.description:
BI Developer (Sigma Computing)


London (Hybrid) | 6-Month Contract |Insurance


A leading insurance organisation is seeking an experienced BI Developer with strong Sigma Computing expertise to join their data and analytics function on an initial 6-month contract.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a business that has invested heavily in a modern cloud data platform, with Snowflake as the enterprise data warehouse and Sigma Computing as the strategic reporting and analytics tool.


We are looking for a highly skilled BI Developer who can leverage data within Snowflake and build intuitive, business-facing dashboards and reporting solutions through Sigma. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders across the organisation to deliver meaningful insights that drive business decision-making.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Designing and developing dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions in Sigma Computing
  • Building and maintaining Sigma Workbooks, Datasets, and visualisations
  • Working closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver analytical solutions
  • Creating KPI reporting and management dashboards across insurance functions
  • Writing complex SQL queries and working directly with data within Snowflake
  • Supporting the adoption of self-service BI capabilities across the business
  • Collaborating with Data Engineering teams to optimise reporting performance and data accessibility
  • Ensuring reporting solutions are scalable, accurate, and aligned with business requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience as a BI Developer, Business Intelligence Developer, or Analytics Developer
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sigma Computing
  • Experience building dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions using Sigma
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience working with Snowflake
  • Solid understanding of data modelling and data warehousing concepts
  • Excellent stakeholder management and requirements-gathering skills
  • Ability to communicate complex data and insights to non-technical audiences

Desirable Experience

  • Specialty Insurance
  • Lloyd's Market
  • London Market Insurance
  • Reinsurance
  • Underwriting
  • Claims
  • Financial Services

The Ideal Candidate


This role will suit a BI professional with deep Sigma Computing expertise who can quickly add value within an established Snowflake environment. You'll be passionate about delivering high-quality analytics solutions and comfortable working directly with business users to transform data into actionable insights.

Contract Details

  • Initial 6-month contract
  • Hybrid working (London)
  • Competitive day rate
  • Immediate start preferred


If you have strong Sigma Computing experience and are looking for your next contract opportunity within a leading insurance organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Infrastructure Engineer (MSP)
job.description:
The position of Project Engineer is suited to an experienced Microsoft cloud and infrastructure engineer/consultant who has previously worked within a managed service provider (MSP) or customer-facing technical services environment.
The role is responsible for delivering Modern Workplace, Microsoft 365, Azure, identity, endpoint management, cyber security, and hybrid infrastructure projects for customers. The successful candidate will be expected to work independently on complex customer engagements, combining strong technical delivery with commercial awareness, documentation discipline, and professional judgement.


Working with the Project Team Lead, the Project Engineer will scope, plan, implement, and hand over technical projects proficiently and within budget. The role may also include producing implementation plans, contributing to solution design, supporting junior engineers, liaising with customers and third-party vendors, and ensuring solutions are secure, supportable, and aligned to customer requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver customer IT projects professionally, securely, and within agreed scope, timescales, and budget.
  • Lead discovery, workshops, implementation planning, migration readiness, and handover activities.
  • Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, licensing considerations, and blockers, escalating where required.
  • Produce clear implementation plans, deployment notes, configuration records, risk updates, and handover documentation.

Experience:

  • Previous experience working for a managed service provider or in a customer-facing technical consultancy role.
  • Previous experience delivering Microsoft 365, Azure, cloud migration, infrastructure, or modern workplace projects.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Teams, and Microsoft 365 tenant configuration.

Location London

Background

job.title: Technical Delivery Manager (Banking)
job.description:
Technical Delivery Manager/Project Manager

Overview of the Role:
As an experienced Technical Delivery Manager/Project Manager, you'll be at the heart of project delivery, working closely with various business departments. This role involves end to end hands-on project management from capturing requirements to post-delivery support.

job.title: AVP Financial Crime Case Worker
job.description:
Location: Glasgow
Rate: Up to £400 per day, Inside IR35
Level: AVP
Sector: Banking / Financial Services
Engagement: Contract

The Opportunity


We are looking for experienced AVP-level Financial Crime Case Workers to support a major programme within a leading UK bank.
The position will focus on the ownership and investigation of complex and higher-risk cases, requiring strong Financial Crime knowledge, investigative capability and sound risk-based judgement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of complex and higher-risk Financial Crime cases.
  • Conduct detailed investigations and case reviews.
  • Analyse customer information, documentation and potential risk indicators.
  • Perform risk assessments and make well-supported, risk-based recommendations.
  • Identify cases requiring further escalation or specialist review.
  • Maintain clear and defensible case records and decision rationale.
  • Ensure cases adhere to internal policies and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Manage cases efficiently through to resolution.
  • Engage with Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime and operational stakeholders.
  • Support less experienced case workers where required.

Experience Required

  • 5+ years' relevant experience within Banking or Financial Services.
  • Strong Financial Crime case management or investigations background.
  • Experience within AML, KYC, Financial Crime, Risk, Compliance or Investigations.
  • Demonstrable experience managing complex or higher-risk cases.
  • Strong investigative and analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent risk assessment and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to make clear, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written communication and case documentation skills.

Engagement


These opportunities are expected to operate on a right-to-hire model, providing the potential for successful contractors to transition into permanent opportunities with the client.

job.title: Date Engineer (Palantir)
job.description:
Date Engineer with Data Migration , Pipeline Migration & Palantir
Location: Leeds, UK or Reading, UK
Travel Requirements: Mostly Remote - Travel to offices as required

About the Role:

Data Engineer with Data Migration , Pipeline Migration & Palantir

Build and improve the data pipelines that turn healthcare information into reliable measures, reports and published outputs. Positions cover metric calculation, governed data stores, reporting datasets and analytical pipeline migration. Some positions also develop the applications used to review and approve data.

Responsibilities
• Develop reusable transformations and data models, with clear definitions, identifiers, reporting periods and version information.
• Implement validation, merge and correction rules, reliable refresh, and safe recovery or reruns after a failure.
• Integrate approved outputs with reporting and publication services, preserving access controls and the meaning of the data.
• Automate tests and reconcile results with agreed business rules; investigate discrepancies with analysts and testers.
• Maintain reviewed code, monitoring, technical documentation and release evidence for your assigned components.

Essential experience
• Strong SQL and production coding in Python or an analytical language relevant to the assignment.
• Data modelling, transformation design, data quality, reconciliation and reliable pipeline processing.
• Source control, code review, automated testing and practical production troubleshooting.
• Ability to clarify analytical requirements and own an agreed component through testing and release.

Assignment focus
• Foundry delivery: practical Palantir Foundry engineering is required for these positions; work includes metric pipelines, metadata, governed storage and reporting outputs.
• Pipeline migration: understand and refactor existing code, work in the confirmed source and target tools, and prove that analytical results remain correct.
• Data applications: where assigned, proven application delivery is required for review and approval workflows, permissions and audit history using the selected Foundry or custom application approach.

job.title: Boomi Integration Architect
job.description:
.

Boomi Solution Architect


Remote | Occasional Travel to London/Telford | 3-Month Contract | Outside IR35

Boomi Solution Architect | Integration & API Platform Programme


We are seeking an experienced Boomi Solution Architect to support the adoption and evolution of a strategic enterprise integration platform within a large-scale government environment.
This is a client-side architecture role requiring a strong blend of technical expertise, integration architecture leadership, governance, and stakeholder engagement. You will be responsible for driving the adoption of strategic integration capabilities across multiple programmes, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and avoid the proliferation of point-to-point integrations.
The successful candidate will possess deep expertise across Boomi iPaaS, API Management, Event Streaming, Integration Architecture, and Enterprise Governance, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Project Onboarding

  • Support the onboarding of strategic programmes onto the enterprise integration platform.
  • Produce solution designs aligned with approved integration, API and event streaming patterns.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and provide design recommendations.
  • Support projects throughout discovery, design and implementation phases.
  • Ensure adoption of strategic integration capabilities over tactical point-to-point solutions.

API Management & Governance

  • Design and implement API management and lifecycle governance processes.
  • Define standards for API design, security, versioning, observability and publication.
  • Support the development of strategic API catalogues and reusable API products.
  • Drive consistency and governance across API delivery teams.

Event-Driven Architecture

  • Define event streaming architecture standards and implementation guidance.
  • Establish governance models for event taxonomy, topic management and event ownership.
  • Support onboarding of initial event-driven use cases.
  • Create reusable event streaming patterns for wider organisational adoption.

Integration Standards & Reusable Assets

  • Develop reusable implementation patterns, templates and reference architectures.
  • Create architecture guidance covering:
    • API integrations
    • Event-driven integrations
    • Managed File Transfer (MFT)
    • Hybrid connectivity solutions
    • Security and authentication models
  • Produce onboarding accelerators and implementation guidance for delivery teams.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architecture leadership, coaching and technical direction to engineering teams.
  • Review solution designs and challenge implementation approaches where required.
  • Support agile delivery teams through design reviews and technical decision-making.
  • Work closely with suppliers and internal delivery teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Operational Readiness & DevSecOps

  • Define architecture requirements covering:
    • Observability
    • Monitoring
    • Logging
    • Alerting
    • Resilience
    • Disaster Recovery
    • DevSecOps integration
  • Support production readiness and operational assurance activities.
  • Ensure solutions meet security, resiliency and operational standards.

Governance & Assurance

  • Establish architecture review and assurance processes.
  • Define technical standards, guardrails and compliance criteria.
  • Support Technical Design Authority (TDA) and Design Authority governance activities.
  • Ensure delivered solutions align with enterprise architecture principles.

Platform Roadmap & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify capability gaps and opportunities across integration, API and streaming platforms.
  • Support roadmap development and future platform evolution.
  • Contribute to proofs of concept and emerging technology evaluations.
  • Provide recommendations for strategic platform enhancements.

Data Sharing Solution Design

  • Analyse data-sharing requirements and associated constraints.
  • Develop integration-led solution options using API, iPaaS and event streaming capabilities.
  • Produce end-to-end solution designs covering:
    • Data flows
    • Integration patterns
    • Security controls
    • Governance requirements
    • Assurance considerations
  • Support transition from discovery into delivery.

Essential Experience

  • Proven experience as a Boomi Solution Architect, Integration Architect, or Enterprise Integration Architect.
  • Strong expertise in Boomi AtomSphere/iPaaS.
  • Experience designing and governing enterprise integration platforms.
  • Strong API Management architecture experience.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture and event streaming patterns.
  • Knowledge of integration security, authentication and governance frameworks.
  • Experience creating reusable architecture patterns and standards.
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience supporting architecture assurance and governance forums.
  • Hands-on involvement in large-scale integration transformation programmes.

Desirable Experience

  • Public sector or government programme experience.
  • Experience working within highly governed environments.
  • Exposure to enterprise architecture frameworks and design authority processes.
  • Experience working with supplier and multi-vendor delivery models.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps and modern cloud integration practices.

Security Clearance

  • Candidates must be SC Cleared or eligible for SC Clearance.

job.title: Senior Security & Cyber Operations Manager (Financial Services)
job.description:
Role: Senior Security and Cyber Operations Manager
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Senior Security & Cyber Operations Manager | Operations, Incident Response & AI Innovation

  • End-to-end operational ownership of enterprise security operations (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and cyber defence capabilities.
  • Drive detection engineering, SOAR automation, and AI integration across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, endpoints, and third-party services.
  • Key focus: Incident leadership, MSSP/vendor management, response playbooks, metrics (MTTD/MTTR), and executive risk governance.

About the Opportunity
A leading UK financial services organisation is seeking a high-performing Senior Security and Cyber Operations Manager to lead, mature, and optimize its end-to-end security operations and cyber defence ecosystem.
Reporting directly to the CISO, you will act as the organizational subject matter expert for incident response, threat monitoring, and operational cyber risk. In this hands-on leadership role, you will bridge the gap between real-time threat telemetry and executive risk decision-making—ensuring security events are rapidly detected, contained, remediated, and learned from. You will also lead the vendor management of external MSSP partners while leveraging AI, SOAR, and intelligent data enrichment to build a modern, high-velocity SOC function.
Key Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Cyber Defence Ownership: Lead the complete operational lifecycle across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, and identity telemetry—covering monitoring, alert triage, incident containment, root-cause eradication, and post-incident learning.
  • Major Incident Response & Crisis Leadership: Act as the operational escalation point during major security events; lead crisis containment strategies, evidence collection, regulatory reporting, and executive updates.
  • AI, SOAR & Continuous Improvement: Champion the practical application of AI, orchestration, and automated triage to reduce alert fatigue, minimize false positives, streamline investigations, and accelerate response playbooks.
  • Vendor & MSSP Governance: Own relationships with external managed security service providers (MSSPs), threat intelligence vendors, and incident response retainers, ensuring SLA compliance, delivery quality, and value alignment.
  • Cross-CIO Collaboration: Work across Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Architecture to embed threat detection models, logging standards, and incident playbooks directly into operational pipelines.
  • Governance & Executive Metrics: Define and maintain core performance metrics (MTTD, MTTR, telemetry health, alert fidelity) and deliver actionable reporting for CISO, Risk Committee, and Board discussions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise Operations Leadership: Proven track record managing SOC, cyber defence, or incident response functions in complex, regulated environments (Financial Services/Insurance preferred).
  • Technical Depth in Security Tooling: In-depth knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, threat intelligence platforms, and telemetry architectures across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Incident Management Mastery: Demonstrable experience leading major security incidents, assessing severity, defining containment strategies, and executing post-incident root-cause remediation.
  • MSSP & Partner Management: Direct experience governing external managed security service providers and third-party incident response retainers.
  • AI & Automation Focus: Practical understanding of applying AI, machine learning, or SOAR playbooks to automate security workflows and enrich threat triage.
  • Executive Stakeholder Communication: Ability to translate complex technical cyber incidents into clear business risk impact and pragmatic recommendations for senior leadership.

job.title: Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager
job.description:
Role: Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager | Hands-On AI & Exposure Leader

  • End-to-end operational ownership of enterprise exposure, vulnerability management, and zero-day response capabilities.
  • Drive modern risk-based prioritisation and AI-driven automation across cloud, infrastructure, and application estates.
  • Key focus: Strategy execution, cross-CIO collaboration, backlog reduction, and executive-level governance.

About the Opportunity
A leading UK financial services organisation is looking for a high-performing Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager to own and evolve its end-to-end vulnerability management and response framework.
Reporting directly to the Deputy CISO, you will act as the organizational authority on exposure management. In this hands-on, high-impact role, you will bridge the gap between technical risk and business reality—ensuring vulnerabilities across infrastructure, cloud, and applications are identified, prioritised, remediated, and reported in a disciplined, risk-based manner. Additionally, you will champion the practical application of AI and intelligent automation to modernise triage, threat correlation, and remediation workflows.
Key Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Vulnerability Ownership: Own the enterprise lifecycle across infrastructure, cloud, apps, and third-party services—covering scanning, triage, risk prioritisation, mitigation, and verification.
  • Hands-On Delivery & Response: Manage vulnerability backlogs, ageing, high/critical remediation activity, scan coverage, and emergency response to zero-day exposures.
  • AI, Automation & Innovation: Champion the practical use of AI and data-driven insights to optimise triage, reduce false positives, perform root-cause clustering, and automate reporting.
  • Cross-CIO Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Architecture teams to embed vulnerability response into existing delivery pipelines rather than treating it as a parallel task.
  • Governance & Executive Reporting: Define and track KPIs/KRIs (SLAs, exposure trends, backlog health) and deliver concise, actionable reporting for CIO leadership, Audit, and CISO/Board forums.
  • Risk & Regulatory Support: Align exposure decisions to organizational risk appetite, manage formal risk acceptances, and drive audit and regulatory remediation actions to closure.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise Exposure Experience: Proven track record running vulnerability management and response within complex, highly regulated environments (Financial Services/Insurance preferred).
  • Technical Breadth: Strong hands-on understanding of vulnerability management principles, tooling, and remediation across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, applications, and platforms.
  • Risk-Based Prioritisation: Expertise in context-aware risk scoring (combining CVSS, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack surface, and business impact).
  • Forward-Looking Mindset: Genuine interest and practical experience in leveraging AI, machine learning, or automated tooling to streamline cyber operations.
  • Influence & Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex technical vulnerabilities into clear business risk and drive remediation across engineering teams without relying on formal authority.

To Apply
If you are an energetic, delivery-focused vulnerability leader looking to drive modern, AI-enabled exposure management within a fast-paced environment, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.

job.title: Deputy CISO
job.description:
Role: Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (Deputy CISO)
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Deputy CISO | Senior Cyber Delivery Leader

  • Hands-on delivery execution of enterprise-wide cyber strategy.
  • Second-in-command to CISO with high visibility across CIO and Executive forums.
  • Key focus: Strategy execution, cross-functional collaboration, governance, and regulatory resilience.

About the Opportunity
A market-leading UK financial services business is seeking a high-performing Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (Deputy CISO) to lead the operational execution of its cyber security roadmap.
Reporting directly to the CISO, you will act as second-in-command, driving delivery across complex technology domains while deputising across executive, risk, audit, and regulatory committees. This is a hands-on leadership role focused on turning strategic cyber objectives into structured, transparent, and high-impact delivery.
Key Accountabilities

  • Executive Deputisation: Act as primary deputy for the CISO across CIO leadership, board-level risk committees, and regulatory engagements.
  • Hands-On Delivery Leadership: Own the operational execution of the cyber roadmap; sequence initiatives, remove blockers, and drive delivery performance across complex environments.
